basic_info.description: Loving this Fall crisp air... And you are going to love this gorgeous, extra large ultra luxury condo in Pacific Heights sitting just one block to Town School and Alta Plaza park.  No need for an elevator because it is located on the first floor!   Even better, because of the hill, you get views of Twin Peaks and USF yet it is on a flat block. Amazing!  You will love how the main living spaces open to the back side of the building (South facing) giving the main entertainment rooms and primary bedroom superb natural light all day!  The  condo has been designer-renovated with a large kitchen with top of the line appliances including the Viking gas stove. This is the largest unit in a small building (only 6 units) and features in-unit Laundry and 2 Car Parking. Additionally there is a huge storage room that could be an office or gym and has outdoor space the entire length of the building.
